name: btn-animated-gradient
title: Animated Gradient Button
blurb: Button with radial gradient highlight that tracks cursor on hover and focus.
description: A button that renders a radial gradient overlay which follows the cursor position when hovered or focused. The gradient fades in on interaction and out when the pointer leaves. State-driven via React hooks.
use_when: A primary CTA that should feel responsive to user interaction with subtle visual feedback.
avoid_when: When minimal visual noise is required or on touch-only interfaces.
a11y: Full keyboard and focus support; gradient appears on focus as well as hover. Uses native button element.
